preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints must be valid vertex indices and must not be the same.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'B', 'R'} for c in colors)
preconditions.description: All edge colors must be either 'B' or 'R'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not possible else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to make all edges the same color, output -1.

postconditions.expression: len(moves) == k and all(1 <= move <= n for move in moves)
postconditions.description: The number of moves k must match the length of the moves list, and all moves must be valid vertex indices.
After applying the moves, all edges must have the same color.
